assessment.nobel_worthiness: Virus-like-particle vaccination against HPV is a decisive preventive advance against common, lethal cancers.
assessment.attribution: The listed scientists represent key conceptual and translational contributions, although the underlying work was collaborative.
assessment.maturity: Large-scale clinical use and sustained cancer-prevention evidence make the impact exceptionally mature.
uncertainties: The relative attribution among foundational VLP and vaccine-development contributors remains difficult to compress into three names.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The identification of distinct lymphocyte lineages established a central framework for adaptive immunity.
assessment.attribution: Miller and Cooper are strongly associated with the complementary T- and B-cell lineage discoveries.
assessment.maturity: The findings have been repeatedly confirmed and underpin modern immunology, vaccination, and immune therapeutics.
uncertainties: The full historical development involved additional experimental contributors.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: High-frequency deep brain stimulation transformed treatment of disabling Parkinsonian motor symptoms and opened a durable therapeutic field.
assessment.attribution: Benabid is the clearly identified principal credited contributor in this candidate formulation.
assessment.maturity: Decades of clinical implementation, refinement, and broad confirmation establish lasting benefit.
uncertainties: Outcomes vary by symptom domain, patient selection, and surgical practice.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: BCR-ABL inhibition made molecularly targeted cancer therapy a clinically compelling reality in chronic myeloid leukemia.
assessment.attribution: The proposed names encompass drug-development, clinical translation, and subsequent validation of the therapeutic principle.
assessment.maturity: Long-term outcomes and the wider influence on precision oncology are well established.
uncertainties: The discovery-to-drug pathway includes important contributions beyond the three proposed laureates.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Antisense correction of SMN2 splicing provided a powerful mechanism-based treatment for a previously devastating neuromuscular disease.
assessment.attribution: Krainer and Bennett credibly represent the central splicing biology and therapeutic antisense-development components.
assessment.maturity: Clinical benefit is established and the work has demonstrated a broader route for RNA therapeutics.
uncertainties: Long-term comparative outcomes and the boundaries of generalization to other RNA disorders continue to develop.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: GLP-1 physiology enabled a major therapeutic advance in diabetes and obesity with extensive public-health importance.
assessment.attribution: The proposed laureates reflect key work on GLP-1 identification, physiology, and therapeutic development; credit is necessarily distributed.
assessment.maturity: The clinical effects and broad adoption of incretin-based therapies are firmly established.
uncertainties: Attribution across discovery, peptide biology, pharmacology, and industrial drug development is contested.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Massively parallel sequencing reshaped biological research, genetic diagnosis, and the practical scale of genomic medicine.
assessment.attribution: The listed names capture important platform innovations, while the technological lineage contains several competing contributions.
assessment.maturity: Its scientific and medical consequences are extensive, reproducible, and now deeply embedded in practice.
uncertainties: The field has multiple platform origins and the appropriate attribution boundary is unusually complex.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optogenetic control created an exceptionally powerful causal method for analyzing defined cells and neural circuits.
assessment.attribution: The proposed names represent the microbial photoreceptor foundations and their transformative deployment in biology.
assessment.maturity: The approach has been broadly reproduced, diversified, and has changed experimental neuroscience and physiology.
uncertainties: Several indispensable contributors are listed, making a three-person attribution incomplete.
